ImageDescription.value: Explore the timeless elegance of Crewe Hall's interior design, nestled in the picturesque Cheshire countryside of England. Adorned with intricate Tudor and Jacobean details, this historic manor house boasts ornate ceilings, rich wood paneling, and majestic fireplaces that whisper tales of centuries past. Each room invites you to wander through opulent corridors, adorned with exquisite tapestries and antique furnishings, while grand chandeliers cast a soft glow upon the plush carpets below. From the grandeur of the Great Hall to the intimacy of the drawing rooms, every space exudes a sense of refinement and luxury, creating a truly unforgettable experience.

Categories.value: Interior of Palácio do Freixo|Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 missing SDC copyright license|Creative Commons Attribution missing SDC copyright status|Flickr images missing SDC copyright status|Flickr images missing SDC creator|Flickr images missing SDC inception|Flickr images missing SDC source of file|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|April 2026 in Porto|Flickr images missing SDC published in

ImageDescription.value:
This image captures the breathtaking grandeur of an opulent salon, possibly within a historic palace or stately home. The room is lavishly decorated with gilded mouldings and intricate frescoes adorning the domed ceiling and walls, depicting mythological scenes with cherubic figures. Large, elegant paintings are set within ornate frames on the pale green walls, interspersed with tall, fluted columns. The space is further enhanced by a series of large, antique mirrors that reflect the light and the room's elaborate details.

The furnishings are both elegant and comfortable, with plush blue armchairs and a long sofa arranged around a dark wooden coffee table. A display cabinet filled with items, a wooden desk with books and a lamp, and a side table contribute to the room's sense of lived-in luxury. The floor is a striking combination of a patterned parquet wood in the foreground and a soft, intricately patterned carpet in the background, adding layers of texture and visual interest.

Natural light streams in from a large, oval skylight in the ceiling, casting dramatic sunbeams across the floor and highlighting the rich textures and colours of the room. Sunlight also enters from a doorway to the left, illuminating a glimpse of another richly appointed area. The overall impression is one of refined elegance, historical richness, and a serene, sun-drenched atmosphere.

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Texas Historical Commission plaques in Grayson County, Texas

ImageDescription.value:
Texas Historical Commission marker #11537, "Site of Old Sherman Opera House", Sherman, Grayson County, Texas. Erected 1969.

Inscription: Formerly a 3-story Victorian structure with twin cupolas. Built by Capt. L. F. Ely, who made the bricks in his city factory. Lavish interior had carpeted aisle, damask curtains and red plush seats. Benches in economy section were called the "Buzzard Roost". From its completion (1881) until closing (1918), it helped make Sherman a cultural center. First show was operetta "The Mikado". Also given here were Shakespearean plays, musical reviews, temperance lectures and trained animal acts. Remodeled (1961) for commercial use. Original bricks remain.

Original caption:

The Bayview Restaurant is Guantanamo Bay's fine dining establishment. The Bayview's dining room has a warm and cozy atmosphere with its plush carpets and warm decor while overlooking magnificent water views of Guantanamo Bay. The caring & warm Bayview staff welcomes guests to enjoy an evening of elegant dinning. Our extensive menu has just the right selection for every taste, which includes our popular Steak Salad, tenderizing appetizers like Shrimp Ceviche, Pizza a la Italian and our Stuffed Mushroom Caps. Classic entrees like Veal Marsala, Stuffed Pork Chop, Porter House Steak and Lobster Thermadore. We also have a selection of house creations like Stuffed Chicken Breast, Pan Seared Duck Breast, Lamb Chops, and who can forget dessert. Come in and try our Double Mini Cake or our Coconut Flan, as well as our ever popular Cherry Bomb. Sharing a bottle of wine at the Bayview is a perfect way to start off your dining experience. Don't have a shirt & tie? That's completely fine you can have the same dining experience on our fabulous scenic patio while the sun sets. Don't want to miss that game? Join us in Rick's lounge where you can get fine dining food in a more casual environment (Officer's Only). Create your own meal at the Bayview Thursday nights with our Mongolian BBQ. Make your selection of fresh meats such as beef, pork, turkey and shrimp and pile your plate with all the fresh vegetables you like. We have assorted sauces you can choose from to create your own. Our award winning culinary team awaits your arrival at the grill and cooks your creation to perfection.
